=== Possible A. Glascow, 1794 arrival ===
A. Glascow from Glasgow is named with H. Jurriens from Riga and J. Mark from Königsbergen in a shipping-arrival report for 24 June 1794, under the Rotterdam dateline of 25 June.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/1335425007/ Rotterdamse courant, 26 June 1794, p.2].</ref>

Only the initial A. is given. The list probably names a shipmaster, but it does not state a vessel, full forename, sex, family or personal origin. Glasgow is the departure port. P. L. Markwaarden in the following entry is a different person.

This may concern [[Glasgow-3902]]. Chronologically adult. The known account records him as a farmer and has no maritime or Rotterdam connection; occupation and place make him a weak lead but do not by themselves prove he could not have had earlier seafaring work.
